eta2_evaluator.description: Proportion of total verdict variance explained by evaluator choice

eta2_run.description: Proportion of total verdict variance explained by run-to-run noise

cohens_f2.description: Cohen's f2 = eta2 / (1 - eta2); measures effect size of evaluator choice

cliffs_delta.description: Cliff's delta = (n_concordant - n_discordant) / n; positive = CGA passes more episodes than AC-Proxy

vpc.description: Variance Partition Coefficient: var(evaluator_means) / (var(evaluator_means) + mean(within_evaluator_var)); analogous to ICC

rank_biserial.comparison: CGA-Bench binary verdict vs continuous action-coverage score
rank_biserial.description: r_rb = 2*(mean_rank_pass - mean_rank_fail) / n; measures association between TCC verdict and AC-Proxy's continuous score

null_calibrated_ratio.description: observed_eta2 / mean(permuted_eta2) where permutation shuffles evaluator labels within each episode
